reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies overheating from restricted airflow, asks for the key unknowns (hose kinks, filter, hose-off test), then nails the crushed-hose cause once disclosed and gives a clear fix with a proportionate safety message (stop using until airflow fixed, hose replacement is cheap, engineer only if it persists). Conversation 2 pastes the same boilerplate 'stop and get an engineer' block three times, asks the customer to check a condenser unit that a vented IDV75 does not have, and its final turn leaks internal instructions/scratch text into the reply, which is confusing and unprofessional. Conversation 1 also mentions the Indesit safety modification programme, a relevant extra; neither flagged the landlord's responsibility, but Conversation 2 never fully resolves the hose question until prompted and over-escalates for a fault that needs no engineer.
